selectionRule: Prioritize every currently mapped live-store SKU first, then adjacent demand candidates. Reuse previously verified CJ supplier identities before generic discovery, but re-check current sale status, exact variant stock and freight every run. Existing store presence or an active Stripe object never waives supplier identity, stock, exact buyer-destination freight, rights, checkout, fulfillment, or unit-economics verification.

candidates.name: 5-in-1 Electric Spin Scrubber
candidates.searchStrategy: find the exact customer-facing electric spin scrubber product class; prefer rechargeable multi-head stocked variants with compact freight; reject replacement heads, attachments and non-powered brushes

candidates.name: Reusable Pet Hair Removal Tool
queries: pet hair remover furniture car seat
candidates.searchStrategy: revalidate known CJ product first, then prefer compact non-powered reusable fabric/furniture removal tool; reject electric grooming devices, ingestible pet products and chemical treatments

candidates.name: Crevice Cleaning Brush Set
queries: stiff bristle gap cleaning brush set
candidates.searchStrategy: revalidate known CJ product/variant first; only if identity lookup fails, search compact gap/crevice cleaning tools. Never substitute a different variant for the mapped Crevice SKU without a fresh commercial review.

candidates.name: Cordless Pressure Washer
candidates.query: cordless pressure washer portable car washer
queries: cordless pressure washer portable car washer
candidates.searchStrategy: prefer complete cordless washer kits with battery, hose and nozzle set, verified stock and clear variant identity; reject replacement nozzles, hoses, batteries and mains-powered units

candidates.name: Mattress Vacuum
candidates.searchStrategy: prefer complete handheld mattress/bed vacuum units with verified power variant and stock; reject storage bags, replacement filters and generic unrelated handheld vacuums

candidates.name: Portable Garment Steamer
candidates.searchStrategy: revalidate known CJ product/variant first; require the complete garment steamer appliance and correct electrical variant; reject facial steamers, hoses, replacement nozzles and accessories

candidates.name: Self-Squeeze Mini Mop
candidates.searchStrategy: prefer complete compact self-squeeze mop with installed cleaning head; reject replacement pads, full-size floor mops and unrelated squeegees

candidates.name: Drain Hair Catcher and Strainer
candidates.searchStrategy: revalidate known CJ product first, then seek compact universal-size mechanical catcher/strainer with documented dimensions; reject chemical drain cleaners and augers

candidates.name: Portable Home Caddy
candidates.searchStrategy: prefer portable open-top household cleaning/storage caddy with handle and verified dimensions; reject shower-mounted caddies, furniture and oversized organizers

candidates.name: Disposable Toilet Scrubber Brush Kit

candidates.name: Microfiber Car Detailing Cloth Kit

candidates.name: Portable Mini Snack Bag Sealer

candidates.name: Knife and Cutlery Cleaning Brush

candidates.name: Compact Car Trash Can
